Implement 4 fixes across /opt/nxeon/worker/migrate-real.ts and (where noted) /opt/nxeon/worker/migrate-detect.ts (Nxeon migration engine). After editing run `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsc --noEmit` until CLEAN (exit 0) and `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsx --test test/migrate-consolidate.test.ts` (green). Do NOT run the worker, deploy, or commit. Read the relevant regions first. Report per-fix final line numbers. Preserve existing honest gates. IMPORTANT: if you add a field to the `ScanResult` type in migrate-detect.ts, you MUST populate it at EVERY place a ScanResult is constructed (including any mock/sample builders) or tsc will fail — make the field optional (`?`) if that's cleaner.

## FIX ENV-1 — copy systemd `EnvironmentFile=` side-files (a migrated unit currently starts with empty config)
`preflightUnitExecs` (~line 3106) parses `ExecStart`/exec directives and copies missing interpreter files, but NOT `EnvironmentFile=`. A unit reading secrets/config from `EnvironmentFile=/etc/myapp/env` (outside any selected copy dir) is enabled but that file never comes across → the service boots unconfigured. Fix: in the unit-migration path (search where units are copied/enabled ~6262-6320, and/or preflightUnitExecs), parse `EnvironmentFile=` lines from each migrated unit (strip a leading `-`, meaning optional), and for each referenced path NOT already on the target, copy it from the source (reuse the same `copyFromSource`/single-file rsync mechanism preflightUnitExecs uses for exec paths; validate the path with the existing path validator). If it can't be copied, push an honest step naming it. Handle multiple `EnvironmentFile=` lines per unit.

## FIX SCH-1 — migrate systemd TIMERS (timer-driven backups/maintenance currently vanish)
Detection is `systemctl list-units --type=service` (migrate-detect.ts ~720), so `.timer` units are never seen; the copy path only handles `<svc>.service`. Add timer support:
- migrate-detect.ts: enumerate enabled non-distro `.timer` units. Add an OPTIONAL `timers?: {name:string}[]` field to ScanResult (optional to avoid breaking existing ScanResult constructions) and populate it from the scan script (base name, `.timer` stripped), capped (~20). Follow how `services` is detected/emitted and mirror it.
- migrate-real.ts: read the timers from the plan/items (thread them like services are threaded from items). For each migrated timer, copy BOTH `<name>.timer` and its backing `<name>.service`, `systemctl daemon-reload`, `systemctl enable --now <name>.timer`. Reuse the existing unit-copy + preflight machinery. Report each as its own step. If the backing service can't exec, name it. Validate unit names with the existing unit/SVCNAME validators.

## FIX OS-1 — recreate system (uid<1000) app users referenced by units + preserve ACLs/xattrs
(a) System users: user recreation is filtered to uid ≥ 1000 (migrate-detect.ts ~1180/1347), so a `User=appsvc` unit with uid<1000 fails to start and copied files show a bare uid. Fix: capture the `User=`/`Group=` referenced by the MIGRATED systemd units and ensure those accounts exist on the target — create a missing one with `useradd -r` (system account), same name; skip if it already exists. Derive the needed accounts from the units actually migrated (do NOT lower the global uid filter). 
(b) ACLs/xattrs: the file/tree rsync (search `rsyncPull`, `-aHz --numeric-ids` ~4381/4390) lacks `-A`/`-X`, so POSIX ACLs, file capabilities and xattrs are silently dropped. Add `-A -X` to the rsync flags used for file/tree copies (keep `-H --numeric-ids`). Cite the exact flag change.

## FIX OS-2 — runtime-correct remediation text (non-Node units currently get Node instructions)
When a unit is built against a language major the target lacks and can't be auto-installed, the blocker text hardcodes the Node/NodeSource command (~3170-3179) regardless of the actual runtime (`installRuntimeMajor` handles only node ~2958). Fix: make the message runtime-aware — for a python/ruby/php/java/go/dotnet unit emit correct "install <runtime> <major>" guidance (or a generic "install <runtime> major <N> then restart the unit"), not the NodeSource curl. Detect the runtime from the same signal the version-probe allowlist uses (~3028: ruby|perl|java|dotnet|go|gunicorn|uvicorn|uwsgi|php-fpm). Only the message text needs correcting.

## Constraints
- Only THIS agent edits these files now. Match existing style; validate every interpolated value; single-quoted `sh -c '…'`.
- Do NOT regress the container/compose/data-safety/web work already in migrate-real.ts (commit 953289d).
- Finish only when tsc is clean AND the consolidate test passes. Report per-fix final line numbers and, for SCH-1, exactly how timers thread detect→plan→apply and which ScanResult construction sites you touched.
